name: Zen
tagline: A free and open-source fork of Mozilla Firefox with a focus on privacy, customizability and design.
description: Zen Browser is a free and open-source fork of Mozilla Firefox with a focus on privacy, customizability and design.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

compose:
services:
  app:
    image: linuxserver/zen:1.23.4@sha256:254661ea126d98dcedbec1bb57cd0785ebdf3521b69a6b24df0952f60f8eb5a7
    restart: unless-stopped
    environment:
      PUID: $PUID
      PGID: $PGID
      TZ: $TZ
    ports:
      - target: 3000
        published: "${APP_PORT}"
        protocol: tcp
      - target: 3001
        published: 3001
        protocol: tcp
    volumes:
      - type: bind
        source: ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config
        target: /config
